hook: 字根 neg＝否——開關室專管「關掉／否認」。
script: negate 直接否定；abnegate 自我否定放棄。renegade 背叛原陣營。negligent／negligible：疏忽 vs 可忽略的小量。renege 食言反悔；denigrate 抹黑貶低。negotiation 討價還價像半否定半妥協；negative 負面開關。

members.speakLineEn: One confound can negate the causal claim.
members.speakLineZh: 一個混淆變項能否掉因果主張。

members.senseAnchor: deny oneself (something); restrain, especially from indulging in some pleasure; surrender (power or a position)
members.speakLineEn: Leaders who abnegate credit build stronger teams.
members.speakLineZh: 放棄邀功的領導者能建更強團隊。

members.senseAnchor: one who rejects a religion, cause, allegiance, or group for another
members.speakLineEn: A renegade analyst published the null result.
members.speakLineZh: 變節分析者發表了虛無結果。

members.senseAnchor: failing to give proper attention or care
members.speakLineEn: Negligent storage of identifiers is a breach.
members.speakLineZh: 識別資料疏忽儲存即違規。

members.speakLineEn: The bias was negligible under sensitivity checks.
members.speakLineZh: 敏感度檢查下偏差可忽略。

members.senseAnchor: the mistake of not following suit when able to do so; fail to fulfill a promise or obligation
members.speakLineEn: Do not renege on data-sharing pledges.
members.speakLineZh: 不要對資料共享承諾食言。

members.senseAnchor: cause to seem less serious; play down; charge falsely or with malicious intent; attack the good name and reputation of someone
members.speakLineEn: Do not denigrate qualitative work as soft.
members.speakLineZh: 不要把質性工作抹黑成「軟」。

related.synonyms: minimize, belittle, derogate, defame, slander, smirch

members.speakLineEn: A negative finding still updates beliefs.
Methodological abnegation means dropping pet theories.
members.speakLineZh: 方法論克己意味放下寵物理論。

members.speakLineEn: Renegotiate authorship when roles change mid-project.
members.speakLineZh: 角色中途改變時重談作者權。

members.senseAnchor: a negative statement; a statement that is a refusal or denial of some other statement; the speech act of negating
members.speakLineEn: Logical negation flips the claim's truth value.
members.speakLineZh: 邏輯否定翻轉命題真值。

members.speakLineEn: Self-abnegation can hide coercive lab cultures.
members.speakLineZh: 過度克己可能掩蓋強制實驗室文化。

reviewHooks: negligent 疏忽 ≠ negligible 可忽略
pitfalls: negligent（疏忽的人／行為）≠ negligible（小到可忽略）
